claim: "Which Centre-Loire appellation is uniquely allowed to make its rosé from Pinot Gris?" / exp: "one of French appellation law's genuine one-offs"
because: Reuilly is not the only one allowed Pinot Gris in its rosé. Châteaumeillant, which the explanation itself lists as a Centre-Loire satellite, permits Pinot Gris G as an accessory variety in its rosé (gris), up to 15% of the plantings, alongside Gamay (at least 60%) and Pinot Noir. The Touraine AOP rosé list also includes Pinot Gris G. What sets Reuilly apart is that its rosé may be 100% Pinot Gris.
fix: Stem: "Which Centre-Loire appellation may make its rosé entirely from Pinot Gris?" In exp, replace "one of French appellation law's genuine one-offs" with "unusual in French appellation law (Châteaumeillant allows Pinot Gris only as up to 15% of a Gamay-led gris)".
